productContext.summary: Authentication uses JWT; the last release changed the issuer configuration
detail: The authentication service validates JWTs against a configured issuer. Release 2026.09.10 altered the JWT_ISSUER environment variable. Incident INC-382 had the same signature in January and was also an issuer mismatch.

activity.line: diffed deploy/production.yaml against the previous release

activity.summary: Root cause: JWT_ISSUER was set to the API host instead of the auth host
activity.detail: The deployment manifest sets JWT_ISSUER to api.acmecloud.com. Tokens are minted with issuer auth.acmecloud.com, so every token fails the issuer check and the service returns 401 — correctly, against the wrong expectation.

data.rootCause: JWT_ISSUER was changed to the API host during deployment. Tokens are minted with issuer auth.acmecloud.com, but the deployed auth service validates against api.acmecloud.com — every token fails the issuer check, so the service returns 401 for every user on every tenant.
evidence: services/auth/jwt.js:34 — issuer compared strictly against process.env.JWT_ISSUER
Incident INC-382 (January) — identical signature, identical cause

data.title: Fix JWT issuer configuration
data.body: The deployed auth service validated tokens against api.acmecloud.com while they are minted with auth.acmecloud.com. This restores the issuer and fails loudly at boot when it is unset, so the same deployment cannot silently 401 every user again.
data.diff:
--- a/deploy/production.yaml
+++ b/deploy/production.yaml
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@ services:
   env:
-    JWT_ISSUER: api.acmecloud.com
+    JWT_ISSUER: auth.acmecloud.com

--- a/services/auth/jwt.js
+++ b/services/auth/jwt.js
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@ export function verifyToken(token) {
+  assertIssuerConfigured(process.env.JWT_ISSUER);
   const claims = decode(token);
data.note: Opened against a mock code host. The patch on this branch is what exists.

memory.rootCause: Not a defect — a documentation question.

memory.title: GST omitted entirely on renewal invoices
memory.symptom: Invoice generated with no tax line for a tenant that has GST configured
memory.rootCause: The renewal invoice path built its own line items and never called the tax step, so GST was skipped rather than miscalculated.
memory.resolution: Route renewal invoices through the same calculator as new invoices. PR #331.

memory.title: Approval matrix ignores the delegated approver
memory.symptom: Purchase orders sit unapproved while the delegate reports seeing nothing to approve
memory.rootCause: Delegation was stored on the user but the approval query filtered on the original approver id only.
memory.resolution: Include active delegations in the approver lookup. PR #287.

memory.title: Vendor cannot upload documents over 10 MB
memory.symptom: Document upload fails silently for large files
memory.rootCause: The gateway body limit was lower than the limit advertised in the product.
memory.resolution: Raise the gateway limit to match the documented 25 MB and surface a clear error above it.

memory.title: Tenant-wide 401s traced to an environment variable drift
memory.symptom: All users rejected at login shortly after a release
memory.rootCause: A deployment changed an authentication environment variable and nothing asserted the value at boot.
memory.resolution: Restore the value and add a boot-time assertion so the service refuses to start on a mismatch.

memory.title: Webhook deliveries dropped after a retry budget change
memory.symptom: Downstream systems stop receiving events without any error surfacing to the customer
memory.rootCause: The retry budget was reduced below the p99 downstream latency, so slow endpoints were abandoned.
